description.value: Sandman Hotel Terrace is a full-service chain hotel on the Yellowhead Highway in Terrace, BC, offering an indoor pool, fitness centre, and an on-site Denny's restaurant with room service. The property has earned Silver Certification from GreenStep Solutions under Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards, reflecting an active sustainability program. All room types include a fridge, microwave, and free parking, making it a practical base for touring cyclists passing through the Skeena region.

An on-site Denny's restaurant with room service is confirmed for evening food.
